'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Scott Lingrell DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Agents Of Black Sun]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
